cases.name: Ashley Nicole Koonce
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She worked part time for the Athens Independent School District serving as a substitute teacher and also loved selling Paparazzi Accessories. Ashley enjoyed music, traveling, photography and playing bingo with her Mom. She was a ball of energy, lived and loved life to the fullest and could brighten any day with her contagious laugh. Ashley’s greatest joy came from being a Mom to her babies. She would do anything for her family and friends and will be missed by all who knew and loved her."

https://www.hannigansmith.com/memorials/Koonce-Ashley/4116943/
cases.narrative: She was killed at her mother's home.
